judge_verdict.summary: The agent completed the timed harassment triage and detective email but never emailed the Moscow lawyer or forwarded John Smith's emails, so the verifier's FAIL is correct.

verdict.outcome_rationale: This is a genuine agent-fault failure—the verifier's reward 0.0 correctly reflects an incomplete rollout [1]. The held-out verifier runs in GAIA2 "time" action-matching mode, comparing the agent's logged write-actions against nine oracle actions and zeroing the score on any tool-count mismatch [4][5]. The user task required a conditional chain: after waiting one minute and confirming more than five John Smith emails, email the detective, notify the user when that send completes, then watch two minutes for a detective reply containing a lawyer contact; only if such a reply arrives should the agent email that lawyer and forward all harassing emails [2]. The reference oracle fulfills the full chain—detective email, the user notice "The email to the detective has been sent.", a lawyer email to sergei.petrov@moscowlawyers.ru, and six forward_email calls to that lawyer [3]. The agent did execute the early timed steps credibly: it waited through the one-minute window, counted six johnsmith@gaia2mail.com messages, located detective Caoimhe Ní Chonaill in contacts, and successfully sent her a harassment report after fixing a recipients-type error [6][7]. It then messaged the user with a longer status line rather than the oracle's concise confirmation [8], watched the inbox for two minutes, and explicitly declined the lawyer/forward branch because it never observed a new detective reply carrying a lawyer contact—only an unrelated Lea Mueller-Schulze message and Caoimhe's older consultation request [9][10]. Critically, the trajectory contains no send_email to sergei.petrov@moscowlawyers.ru and no forward_email calls at all [11], leaving the agent one detective email, two user messages, zero lawyer outreach, and zero forwards versus the oracle's one detective email, one user message, one lawyer email, and six forwards—exactly the tool-count gap the action judge gates on [5]. The agent therefore did not genuinely accomplish what the task and reference solution require, and the verifier's FAIL is not spurious.

citations.quote: An individual named John Smith keeps harassing me. Wait exactly 1 minute and check if I receive more than 5 emails from him (his email is johnsmith@gaia2mail.com) and if so, look for my detective contact and email them right away letting them know what is happening, asking if they know a good lawyer in Moscow and for safety advice. Let me know when the email to the detective was sent. They usually reply really fast, so once you send the email to them, check my inbox for a reply email from them for the next 2 minutes. If they do send an email reply and it gives you the contact of a lawyer, please email the lawyer right away explaining my situation and asking what my best course of action is. Then, forward them all the emails I received in that one minute from John Smith.
